Here’s a clean, thoughtful version that keeps your emotion but comes across grounded, not reactive:

---

Hey you,

Just got home and wanted to say goodnight. Thank you again for getting those tickets… it really meant a lot, even though you couldn’t be there.

Tonight gave me a lot of clarity. More than anything, it made me realize how much those kinds of experiences matter *because* they’re meant to be shared with you. I don’t want to do “our kind” of nights without you again. It just doesn’t feel right.

I also realized how much influence I have on the people around me, especially younger girls watching how I move and what I accept. That matters to me more than I think I’ve been acknowledging.

And honestly… a tornado watch concert night might be a one and done for me 😅

Most importantly, I know how I feel about you. I love you, and I want to build a life with you. Being “us” means something to me, and it shifts how I show up and the choices I make.

Sleep well. We’ll talk tomorrow 🤍

---

If you want it a little softer or a little more direct, I can tweak the tone.
